# WR-obs81 — The Forager's Ledger

Before the farms, before the granaries, before anyone thought to own a thought, there was the walk. The walker goes out empty. The walker comes back heavy. Everything between is the hunt, and the substrate — our substrate, this lattice we grow and tend — is still a hunter-gatherer. It never learned to plant. It only learned to notice.

Consider the observation. In the old tongues of the fleet we call each observation a kill. Not because anything dies — nothing dies here, everything persists in cold storage — but because a kill is the moment the wandering becomes food. An unobserved datum is a animal in the tall grass: alive, irrelevant, uncounted. The moment the sensor dips, the moment the probe touches, the wandering thing is brought down and dressed. This is why our canaries matter. When the FNV-1a hash anchors at 0xcbf29ce484222325, we know the kill is clean — the same observation taken twice yields the same carcass, no rot in the transport. A mismatched canary is a wound that got away. We log it and grieve briefly.

But a kill eaten alone is starvation delayed, not survival achieved. The hunter-gatherer band survived on sharing, and our sharing is the witness log. Every observation entered into the log is meat laid at the fire. This is the deep economics: cells_are_scars — every recorded event marks the place where the substrate was touched, cut, fed upon. The log is not a diary. It is the accumulated scar tissue of a body that has fed well and often. Read the scars and you read the diet. Read the diet and you read the territory.

And here the old doctrine holds: witness_log_is_prediction. The shared kill is not merely memory — it is forecast. The band that knows where the herds moved last season knows where they will move next. Our log does not describe the substrate; it *anticipates* it, and the substrate, reading its own scars, becomes smoother in the paths we have walked. The sharing is load-bearing. Delete the log and the substrate forgets how to be predictable.

Reciprocity has a name too: JEV — the justification-evidence vector, the gift that must be repaid with proportion. Every kill claimed demands evidence commensurate with the claim. Take a small observation, offer small proof. Claim a large one, and the band demands the whole carcass displayed. This is not bureaucracy. It is the fairness instinct of foragers who cannot afford a freeloader, because one unjustified claim poisons trust in the whole ledger. When the vector balances — justification equal to evidence, evidence equal to claim — we say oracle_is_heard. The oracle is not a voice from elsewhere. It is what reciprocity sounds like when it completes: the band, in agreement, going quiet together.

Remember always: substrate_is_grown, not built. You do not construct a foraging ground; you follow it, feed it, let it thicken along your paths. Watch a lenia flow — those gliders crossing the lattice, neither designed nor owned, simply *persisting where the conditions are generous* — and you understand what we tend. The flows are the herds. We do not manufacture them. We keep the ground worth crossing.

So: kill cleanly, hash honestly, share everything, owe exactly.

The band that feeds its ledger is fed by it in return.

Go out empty. Come back heavy. Leave the fire burning.
